es: Reconocer recursos diplomáticos (I'm afraid, perhaps, slightly, I tend to) y ordenarlos según su grado de firmeza al discrepar.

teaching.en: I'm afraid I can't agree with the plan as it stands, but perhaps we could look at another option before we decide.
teaching.es: Me temo que no puedo estar de acuerdo con el plan tal como está, pero quizá podríamos mirar otra opción antes de decidir.
teaching.explanationEs: I'm afraid + oración abre un desacuerdo sin atacar (no lleva of); perhaps + could convierte una orden en propuesta.
segments: I'm afraid I can't agree with the plan as it stands,
but perhaps we could look at another option before we decide.
teaching.audioText: I'm afraid I can't agree with the plan as it stands, but perhaps we could look at another option before we decide.

teaching.en: With all due respect, the date is slightly too early for most of the team, and the budget seems rather optimistic.
teaching.es: Con todo respeto, la fecha es algo temprana para la mayor parte del equipo, y el presupuesto parece bastante optimista.
teaching.explanationEs: with all due respect precede a una crítica firme; slightly y rather suavizan: «algo» y «bastante».
segments: With all due respect, the date is slightly too early for
most of the team, and the budget seems rather optimistic.

teaching.en: I appreciate the effort behind your proposal, but I suppose the cost is a problem, so I suggest we ask the members first.
teaching.es: Agradezco el esfuerzo que hay detrás de tu propuesta, pero supongo que el costo es un problema, así que sugiero que preguntemos primero a los socios.
teaching.explanationEs: I appreciate reconoce lo bueno; I suppose suaviza la afirmación; suggest propone en lugar de ordenar.

teaching.en: Frankly, I tend to think that a shorter trip would be safer, although I may be wrong about the weather.
teaching.es: Sinceramente, tiendo a pensar que un viaje más corto sería más seguro, aunque puede que me equivoque con el clima.
teaching.explanationEs: frankly abre con franqueza y tend to suaviza la opinión; may be wrong deja una puerta abierta.

teaching.en: A tactful colleague rarely says that you are wrong; she says instead that she sees the matter rather differently.
teaching.es: Un colega con tacto rara vez dice que te equivocas; dice, en cambio, que ve el asunto de forma bastante distinta.
teaching.explanationEs: tactful no significa ambiguo: se sigue diciendo lo que se piensa, pero sin atacar a la persona.

teaching.en: I wonder whether the date is fixed, because I suggest we ask everyone before we commit to anything.
teaching.es: Me pregunto si la fecha ya está fijada, porque sugiero que preguntemos a todos antes de comprometernos a nada.
teaching.explanationEs: I wonder whether + oración convierte un desacuerdo en una pregunta abierta; suggest, en una propuesta.

prompt.es: Elige la formulación más diplomática para rechazar la fecha propuesta.

choices.text: Monday at eight is impossible for me, so please choose another day.
I don't think Monday at eight works, so we have to change the date.
I'm afraid Monday at eight is slightly difficult for me; perhaps we could try later?

feedback.es: I'm afraid, slightly y perhaps suavizan el rechazo y ofrecen una salida; las otras dos son más directas y no proponen nada.

hint.es: Busca la que suma un suavizante y una propuesta en lugar de una orden.

origin.text: A colleague proposes holding the review meeting on Monday at eight. You cannot attend, but you want to keep the tone friendly and offer another option.

prompt.es: Completa: «Me temo que no puedo venir el viernes.»

feedback.es: I'm afraid abre un desacuerdo o un rechazo con tacto.

hint.es: Es el adjetivo con el que se abre una negativa amable.

origin.text: Thank you very much for the invitation. I'm ___ I cannot come on Friday, but I would love to meet you another day.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Quizá podríamos mirar otra opción antes de decidir.»

answer.text: Perhaps we could look at another option before we decide

feedback.es: Perhaps + could convierte la idea en una propuesta suave; before we decide marca el momento.

hint.es: Empieza con el adverbio que significa «quizá».

prompt.es: Une cada formulación con su grado de firmeza.

pairs: I'm afraid I see it slightly differently.
I wonder whether there might be another way to look at it.

feedback.es: La firmeza baja cuando se añaden I'm afraid o slightly, y más aún con una pregunta con I wonder whether.

pairs: I'm afraid I see it slightly differently.
I wonder whether there might be another way to look at it.

prompt.es: Escucha el relato de la reunión y elige qué propone Marta.

choices.text: Testing the idea on a smaller scale before committing.
Rejecting the proposal because the budget is too high.
Asking Tom to explain the plan to the team again.

feedback.es: Marta sugiere probar la idea a menor escala; dice que el presupuesto parece optimista, pero no rechaza la propuesta.

origin.audio: At the end of the meeting, the chair asked whether anyone wanted to add anything. Marta said that she appreciated the work behind the proposal, and that she was afraid she saw one difficulty. The budget seemed rather optimistic, and she wondered whether the team could test the idea on a smaller scale first. Then Tom, who tends to be blunt, said simply that the plan would not work. Nobody spoke for a moment, and the chair thanked Marta for her suggestion.

prompt.es: Completa cada frase con el recurso diplomático que encaja.

feedback.es: Suggest propone, rather suaviza el adjetivo tight y Perhaps + could introduce una alternativa.

sentences: I ___ we ask everyone before we commit to anything.
The deadline is ___ tight for a project of this size.
___ we could meet again on Thursday to discuss it?

prompt.es: ¿Qué da a entender Sara con su pregunta sobre el equipo?

choices.text: That she thinks the team has probably not had enough time.
That she has no opinion and only wants some information.
That she will accept the timetable once the figures are checked.
That she would prefer a different team to check the figures.

feedback.es: I wonder whether es una pregunta suavizada: Sara sugiere, sin afirmarlo, que el equipo no ha tenido tiempo suficiente.

origin.text: Dear Tom, thank you for your proposal. With all due respect, I'm not entirely convinced that the timetable is realistic, and I wonder whether the team has had enough time to check the figures. Perhaps we could discuss it on Thursday? Best wishes, Sara.

prompt.es: Completa cada espacio con el recurso que reconoce, suaviza o abre con franqueza.

feedback.es: Appreciate reconoce, tend to suaviza la opinión y Frankly abre con franqueza.

sentences: I ___ your offer, but I'm afraid the price is too high for us.
I ___ to think that a shorter trip would be safer for the group.
___, I think the plan needs more time before we approve it.
origin.text: Pistas en español: valorar, soler, sinceramente.

prompt.es: Escucha el relato y elige qué grado de firmeza muestra Carlos.

choices.text: Blunt: he rejects the idea in an open way.
Neutral: he gives no opinion on the idea.
Soft: he leaves room but shows a real doubt.

feedback.es: Elogia la idea pero añade que la fecha podría ser difícil y que necesita tiempo: suaviza el mensaje sin ocultar su duda.

origin.audio: Carlos answered the proposal after a long pause. He said that he appreciated the idea and that it was certainly interesting. Then he added that he would need some time to think, and that the date might be difficult. He did not say no, but he did not say yes either, and he avoided looking at Mia.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Con todo respeto, me temo que veo la situación de forma bastante distinta.»

answer.text: With all due respect I'm afraid I see the situation rather differently
accepted: With all due respect I'm afraid I see the situation rather differently
I'm afraid with all due respect I see the situation rather differently

feedback.es: With all due respect e I'm afraid se acumulan antes de la posición, y rather suaviza differently.

prompt.es: ¿Con qué propósito escribe Sara este mensaje a Tom?

choices.text: To reject the draft and ask somebody else to write it.
To thank Tom and accept the draft without any changes.
To ask for a change while keeping a friendly tone.
To complain about the amount of work she has done.

feedback.es: Reconoce el trabajo y suaviza la crítica (slightly abrupt) para pedir un cambio y ofrecer su ayuda.

origin.text: Thank you for the draft, Tom. I appreciate how much work you put into it, and I'm afraid the ending seems slightly abrupt to me. Perhaps we could add a short paragraph? I would be glad to help with that.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Me pregunto si podríamos hablar de otra fecha la semana próxima.»

answer.text: I wonder whether we could talk about another date next week

feedback.es: I wonder whether convierte un desacuerdo en una pregunta abierta sobre una alternativa.

prompt.es: Completa: «No estoy del todo convencido de que funcione tal como está.»

feedback.es: Not entirely convinced expresa duda sin rechazar el plan: un desacuerdo parcial y cortés.

origin.text: I would not call the plan a failure, but I am not ___ convinced that it will work in its present form.
